title: Rootstock Software Appoints Frederick Li Chief Product Officer, Promotes Ohad Idan to SVP of AI and Platform Engineering
summary: Rootstock Software appoints Frederick Li as Chief Product Officer to drive AI strategy

sentences: Rootstock Software has appointed Frederick Li chief product officer and promoted Ohad Idan to senior vice president of AI and platform engineering as the cloud enterprise resource planning (ERP) provider expands its artificial intelligence strategy for manufacturers and distributors.
Li will oversee Rootstock’s product strategy, roadmap and development priorities, with an emphasis on bringing AI-powered capabilities to market.
Idan will lead AI-focused engineering initiatives, platform development and technical partnerships.
The appointments are intended to strengthen coordination between product management and engineering as Rootstock works to accelerate software development and expand its technology offerings.
“Rootstock is committed to leading with product, and we need leaders who can help us go where the market is going—and get there ahead of it,” said Rick Berger , CEO of Rootstock Software.
“Frederick brings deep experience launching new products, strong knowledge of AI, and best-in-class product discipline.

And Ohad steps into a role built around his exceptional platform and engineering expertise.”
Li brings more than 15 years of experience in B2B software product leadership.
He previously served as chief product officer at Fishbowl Inventory, a provider of inventory management software for manufacturing businesses, where he helped scale the company’s operations.

Before joining Fishbowl, Li spent more than six years at BlackLine, advancing to vice president of product management for its financial close solutions, which serve midsize businesses and large enterprises.
Earlier in his career, he held product leadership positions at CoreLogic, including roles within the company’s Santa Monica innovation hub.
“The manufacturing and distribution of goods are essential to the economy, and I believe the ERP space is on the cusp of significant evolution,” Li said .

“I want to be part of a company with the appetite to lead this evolution and shorten customers’ time to value.”
In his expanded role, Idan will focus on incorporating AI into Rootstock’s engineering processes to improve development efficiency and accelerate product delivery.
He will also continue working with customers and overseeing technical relationships with the company’s major platform partners.

“With Frederick setting product direction and my new role in engineering, we’ll be able to more rapidly drive product priorities into results and deliver on what customers most want and need,” Idan said.
Rootstock provides cloud-based ERP software for manufacturers, wholesalers and distributors.
Its platform is built natively on Salesforce and supports business processes including manufacturing operations, inventory management and supply chain activities.

The leadership changes come as enterprise software providers increasingly integrate AI into core business applications and development workflows, creating opportunities to automate processes and improve operational decision-making.
Rootstock said the appointments will help align its product and engineering organizations as it develops new capabilities and expands its offerings for product-based businesses.
